profile.name: Xanadus
profile.title: Abyssal Goddess
profile.characteristics: She was once a goddess of the Underworld that was forgotten by history. Empowered with the Abyssal Darkness, the ancient being has become a World Boss.

1.name: Invitation to Abyss
1.description: Charms 1 enemy and deals M.DMG to the target, withdrawing it from battle for 8 sec. The withdrawn target cannot perform any actions or be targeted. Hit enemy has its DMG reduced permanently.

2.name: Curtain of Darkness
2.description: Creates a Curtain of Darkness in the front for 10 sec to deal M.DMG to all enemies every 0.5 sec, reducing their ATK by 50% for 20 sec.

3.name: Wings of Blade
3.description: Strikes the ground with huge wings, deal P.DMG to all enemies, and knock them away.

4.name: Abyssal Nightmare
4.description:
Deals M.DMG to all enemies and heals own HP every 0.5 sec for 10 sec. Upon every heal, permanently reduces damage taken.
In [Abyssal Nightmare] status, takes greatly increased DMG with the [Abyssal Eye] exposed.

5.name: Resistance of Ancient Species
5.description:
Xanadus has fixed ATK Spd and DEF, and has a Crit Resistance of 300.
Casts [Abyssal Nightmare] after casting skills 3 times.
A portion of DMG dealt to the [Abyssal Curse Stone] and [Abyssal Soul Stone] is transferred to Xanadus.

6.name: Obsidian Goddess
6.description:
The [Abyssal Curse Stone] and [Abyssal Soul Stone] of Xanadus will only take 1 DMG at a time from all attacks until the shield is broken.
The shield will be removed for the duration of [Abyssal Nightmare], and it will be cast again when [Abyssal Nightmare] ends.

7.name: Abyssal Core
7.description:
[Abyssal Soul Stone] increases ATK of Xanadus by 50% for 10 sec every 30 sec.
[Abyssal Curse Stone] reduces ATK of 2 enemies that are farthest away by 30% every 20 sec. This effect cannot be dispelled.
